notIdeasOfWhatSocietyShouldBe.explanation: The term is a polemical label coined by critics (del Valle, Cukierman) for an alleged coalition of leftists, Islamists and the far right; no one holds it as a doctrine and it has no texts or programme of its own. I went through the statements looking for any answerable from sources that tie positions to the label itself and found none: the accusers' lists of shared traits (anti-Zionism, anti-capitalism, anti-Americanism) are allegations about other movements' views, not a set of ideas of what society should be.
